reviews.author: Lakesha Harley
reviews.text: Dorsey's paint and body got my ride looking new again. The entire experience was a 10/10 very professional, top quality work and he kept me well informed throughout the process. Dorsey's is now my go to for my body work.

reviews.author: Travis Grable
reviews.text: Dorsey did a great job as always, you can always count on him to get your vehicles to factory standards. He painted a truck for my dad 15 years ago which the paint job is still outstanding! He has painted several vehicles for me as well always excellent work!

reviews.author: Doug Ansley
reviews.text: Don did an excellent job with having to match the paint and doing all the little things to make it look better than the factory paint. Recommend Dorsey Paint and Body to anyone looking for that professional touch along with the highest of quality work.

reviews.author: Kevin coleman
reviews.text: Dorcey did a phenomenal job fixing my truck. Highly recommend him. Somebody pulled out in front of us and ripped off my mirror and Mr. Dorcey replaced it and repainted the entire side of the truck looks amazing.

reviews.author: Trinia Greene
reviews.text: I can’t say enough great things about Dorsey Paint & Body! From start to finish, they exceeded all my expectations. My car was towed to Mr. Dorsey shop from a car accident. The team was incredibly professional, taking the time to walk me through the process and ensure every detail was flawless. When I picked up my car, I was blown away, the finish was smooth, the color was rich and vibrant, and it looked like it had just rolled off the showroom floor. Not only did they do an amazing job with the repairs and paint, but they also went above and beyond with their customer service. They kept me updated with progress and made sure I was 100% satisfied before I drove away. If you’re looking for top-tier quality, precision, and outstanding service, Dorsey Paint & Body is the place to go. I highly recommend them to anyone who wants their car to look brand new again!

reviews.author: Kristian Freeman
reviews.text: I got into an accident last month. I was stressed out trying to figure out who was going to fix my car. I called Dorsey’s Paint and Body and all of my stresses went away. He handled everything from staying in touch with the auto adjuster all the way up until getting me my car back. They got my car back to me quicker than I expected. When I got my car back, the work was incredible!! You would not be able to tell it was in an accident at all. They will definitely handle anything for me in the future and I will definitely recommend this shop!!

reviews.author: SYLVIA LOOPER
reviews.text: Mr. Dorsey and his staff are the upmost professionals and did an unbelievable job on the repairs of my Honda Pilot. He was in constant communication with us giving us updates about the progress.. My car was delivered to me looking better than it looked when I bought it. If you want personal and superb service...take all of your body work to Dorsey's. You won't regret it!

reviews.author: Tomeka Symonds
reviews.text: I dropped my car off on a Tuesday and by that Thursday it was ready! When I say the work was impeccable, I mean it. My fender was backed in to as well as the passenger door. My car looks like a brand new car. Even my neighbor asked me if I'd gotten a new car. The inside was just as clean as the outside, so I highly recommend this shop to do any and all of your body work. The owner Mr. Dorsey is great to work with and his team is very friendly. You can tell this company puts customer service and satisfaction first!

reviews.author: Ivey Barnett
reviews.text: My convertible BMW was damaged during Huricane Helene and I had taken it to another prominent bodyshop for repair. They initially told me that the car was repairable but once at their shop, called to say that the convertible top was damaged beyond repair, that the opening mechanism pin was bent, and the entire top had to be replaced which would be over $12k totaling the car. This shop stated to me that BMW does not make replacement parts for tops (which is untrue), and they made this assumption based solely on a visual inspection. Mr. Dorsey was so kind and came to my home, looked at my car, did some research and then informed me that the car was repairable! He checked in with me every few days to keep me updated with the progress. Not only did he fix my car, it looked better than it did before the repairs! I would highly recommend him! Very honest, reasonable and dependable! My car looks showroom sharp!!!

reviews.author: Kathy Griggs
reviews.text: I had two automobiles in practically back to back. The first one was a manufacturing paint issue and he did a jam up job on fixing that issue and wow was it clean. Then only a few days later I said hello to a deer. He brought her back to look better than the day I bought her. I also had leaks that he took care of. He's awesome and a great man to work with. I highly recommend him! Thank you so much for taking great care of me!

reviews.author: Jason Viseth
reviews.text: Mr Dorsey and his staff went above and beyond while repairing my daughter’s vehicle after a vicious deer attack. Her 2012 vehicle looks like new now. Thank you Don!

reviews.author: Dina Conklin
reviews.text: Mr. Dorsey is amazing!!! He is very professional, and handled my car repairs as if they were for his own car! My car was returned to me looking even better than it looked before my accident, and clean!!! Iam a very happy customer! He is very kind and responds immediately to calls and messages. I would highly recommend his shop. I plan to use his shop again, if we ever need repairs. I am also recommending him to family and friends. Thank You Mr. Dorsey and your employees for your loyalty and amazing customer service!!!

reviews.author: Alphonso Bell
reviews.text: A deer had ran to the side of my truck. Set it up with Dorsey. Three days later my truck is back to showroom floor quality!!!!

reviews.author: Alice Adams
reviews.text: Honest, reliable, dependable and up front service. Very knowledgeable and kept me and my son informed on what was going on with the car. Sorry I don't have any before and after pictures but the car look new again. Great body work and paint job. They even cleaned the car out (that's a plus). Can't go wrong with Dorsey's Paint and Body.

reviews.author: Hope Campbell
reviews.text: Dorsey Paint and Body has done bodywork and paint on a car and a truck of mine. Mr. Dorsey is very professional, honest, and has the utmost integrity. Both times his work truly exceeded my expectations. He kept me informed of the progress and delays. I was more than appreciative of the delays once I saw my vehicles; it proved that he put pride in the quality of his craft. I would highly recommend Dorsey Paint and Body to anyone looking to restore, repaint, or just looking to “pimp your ride” Mr. Dorsey is your guy. Give him a try. You won't be disappointed. I would 100% take my business back to Mr. Dorsey.

reviews.author: Shannon Hamilton
reviews.text: I’m giving 5 stars, because it didn’t have the option to give 10. Such an awesome company! Amazing work and quality! The best customer service I’ve ever had. They went above and beyond and did a Wonderful job! I highly, HIGHLY recommend Dorsey’s!!! My car looks better now, than before I bought it! Thank y’all for your hard work and dedication to getting me back on the road!

reviews.author: Charlotte Young
reviews.text: Mr.Dorsey is very professional, dependable and provides excellent customer service. He has done paint and body work on two of my vehicles and both were perfect when he was finished. I highly recommend Dorsey’s Paint and Body!

reviews.author: breanna benenhaley
reviews.text: Mr.Dorsey was professional, fast, and went above and beyond to make sure my car looked just as it did before the accident. Highly recommend you give him the opportunity to help you as well.

reviews.author: Travis Jones
reviews.text: This is the best paint and body shop in Edgefield County. When you take and get your vehicle back you really don’t recognize your car from the excellent job these guys have done. I’m not pulling anyone legs. This is my second vehicle I have taken to them and I was more than satisfied.

reviews.author: mary watson
reviews.text: i am extremely pleased with the work Mr. Dorsey and his staff did. My truck had several spots where the paint had completely peeled away. An excellent paint job and detailing has the truck looking like it just came off the showroom floor.

reviews.author: Crystal Fields
reviews.text: Mr. Dorsey did a wonderful job on my car. He is super friendly and professional. If I could give more than five stars, I would. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Bailey Pendarvis
reviews.text: Mr. Dorsey has done an excellent job on my vehicles! When you have the owner of the company that manages and performs the work on your vehicle you know the outcome will be great!!

reviews.author: Kristin J
reviews.text: Due to a car accident my Toyota Sienna had a lot of damage. Don was able to repair all of the damage and match the color perfectly. My van shined like it was new off the lot. I highly recommend Dorsey's

reviews.author: johnny FoodHawk
reviews.text: This Bodyshop is either one of a kind or the best in the whole state of SC. Owner is not only a spectacular person to work with, truthful, and easy to get along with but does work of a perfectionist. Im glad to see this at a 5.0 rating because there should be no reason it ever goes under this. The price and work is something other bodyshops are not going to be able to compete with. If your in Augusta, Saluda, Edgefield, Johnston, Greenwood , or McCormick Abbeville.. you might wanna talk to this man before you go anywhere else.. This is what you call a lost art of a business. The work is just flawless and for the price its going to be hard for you to want to recommend anyone else after you get a taste of what this guy can do.. 5 stars.. should be 10.. LEGEND!

reviews.author: Gena Hough
reviews.text: I discerned that Don was trustworthy and professional after meeting him . My intuitions were correct He was very accommodating in getting my car to and from his shop and the paint job on my car was perfect as well as timely. The pride he takes in his workmanship was worthy and appropriate. I would surely use him again.

reviews.author: Natalie Ginger
reviews.text: It isn’t often you find a business owner who cares about the small details, the ones nobody sees, as much as the showy ones. And there were some showy vehicles in there! But he still took the time to make sure my little bruised truck got fixed up quick, because he’s a professional and a gentleman.

reviews.author: clint Chapman
reviews.text: Mr Dorsey has always done a great job for me and conducts his work very professionally. I highly recommend him and his staff to take care of your vehicle!!!

reviews.author: Gone Blind
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of having my car painted by Dorsey's Paint and Body. Wonderful customer service an excellent paint job. Thank you for everything Sincerely Jo Ann Stewart

reviews.author: Tamiko Bunch
reviews.text: Mr. Dorsey was very kind and patient with me as well as State Farm. He went beyond what he needed to do to make us satisfied customers. I would use him again and again

reviews.author: Vicky Lott
reviews.text: I was totally satisfied with the quality of work Don did on my car I wouldn’t take any of my vehicles any place else? Top quality work? 5 stars all the way, Vicky Lott Edgefield SC

reviews.author: Sheronda Gray
reviews.text: Thank you Mr Don you and your guys did a EXCELLENT JOB on my car!!!!! Deer damage …. I would tell anybody who need body work or paint job… DORSEY PAINT AND BODY is the place to go!!!!

reviews.author: Hope Gore
reviews.text: great customer service and great work! you’d never even know my car was damaged. my car was even washed and vacuumed when i picked it up. definitely recommend

reviews.author: Chris Partain
reviews.text: 100% satisfied with the quality and professionalism from Mr Dorsey. Have recommended him to all my friends and family. Will definitely use again when the time comes!

reviews.author: Gloria Mccladdie
reviews.text: I was totally satisfied with the repairs that Don made to my vehicle! The repairs were flawless! His work is incredible!
